marqueeTimeline._readme: All times are SECONDS on the gsap master timeline unless the key says Ms. All eases are gsap ease strings verbatim. All geometry offsets are in ART-CANVAS pixels (1920x1080) inside the marquee container, which is then scaled by marqueeScale and positioned at the board centre.

designCanvas.note: All six marquee layers (big/mega/epic/max/win/plate) are authored pre-aligned on this one canvas; every geometry fraction below multiplies ART_H (or ART_W where stated).

artLayers.warmUpNote: after Assets.load all six textures are bound to the GPU via a 4x4-frame invisible sprite each, held 150ms, then destroyed — otherwise the first marquee hitches mid-entrance
artLayers._source: src/game/WinCelebration.ts:207-236 (loader/warm-up), :389 marquee.addChild(plateSpr, winSpr, tierSpr), :403 amount; Vice urls src/App.tsx:707-711

gate.belowGate: if (!isMax && r < 15) NO marquee at all; instead onWinJingle(r < 2 ? 'small' : r < 8 ? 'normal' : 'big') and resolve immediately

maxTierGate.exactComparison: const capAmount = capX > 0 ? BigInt(capX) * wager : 0n; const isMax = capAmount > 0n && winAmount >= capAmount;
maxTierGate.note: MAX is decided EXACTLY in BigInt, never on the float ratio r. The retired form `r >= capX * 0.999` is explicitly called out as a bug in the source comment (it celebrated MAX at 4996x of a 5000x cap and can mis-read above 2^53).
maxTierGate._source: src/game/PixiApp.ts:4013-4022; capX value src/data/math_vice_heat.json:269 ("maxWinMultiplier": 5000), default src/engine/GameConfig.ts:135

geometryVICE_GEO.measuredOn: 2026-07-10, Vice v2 art set, from the alpha bboxes
geometryVICE_GEO.swapCondition: setWinTierGeometry() replaces GEO only when the argument carries contentFrac; the Vice call passes sizeMul only, so GEO stays VICE_GEO

geometryResolvedPx._note: DERIVED from geometryVICE_GEO by the formulas in the code — arithmetic only, no new constants. Units = art-canvas px inside the marquee container.
geometryResolvedPx.tierWordAnchorNote: anchor.y = GEO.tierCy[key] so the word pulses around its own centre

marqueeScale.screenFracNote: content height targets 55% of the SHORT screen edge
marqueeScale.tierScaleNote: each promotion multiplies baseMsc by tierScale[n] — the visible size step between stages

amountText.fontFamilySourceVice: WIN_CELEBRATION_CONFIG.amountFont is null for Vice, so the manager font from the PixiApp constructor is used
amountText.refitRule: amount.scale.set(1); if (amount.width > plateInnerW) amount.scale.set(plateInnerW / amount.width) — re-run on EVERY count-up tick, not only at build
amountText.decimalsRule: dp = decimals > 4 ? 2 : decimals; during the count amount.text = counter.val.toFixed(dp)
amountText.finalTextRule: on count complete the text is replaced by formatAmount(winAmount, decimals) — integer-exact half-up rounding in BigInt, not the float

entrance.stampLandNote: the single anchor constant every entrance offset is expressed against

steps.note: fades over most of the drop so the stamp never reads as a 1-frame alpha pop
accelerating IN = weight; baseScale = marquee.scale.x at build = baseMsc * tierScale[0]

steps.condition: only when the plate sprite exists (art path)

landingFlash.kind: additive clone of the CURRENT tier-word sprite added to the marquee

count.driver: ONE gsap tween on a plain object `counter = { val: 0 }` from 0 to finalVal; its onUpdate writes the text, refits it, fires the tally tick and evaluates the live promotions
count.livePromotionCap: liveMax = Math.min(finalTier, 2) — MAX never promotes mid-count
count.promotionScanRule: for (let n = liveMax; n > curTier; n--) if (counter.val >= th[n]) { promoteTier(n); break; }
count.durationsNote: SLOW on purpose so the marquee music is actually heard; each tier counts faster in value/second but LONGER in wall-clock, power1.inOut keeps the top end steady instead of snapping shut

tallyTicks.gateRule: fires when lastTickAt < 0 || performance.now() - lastTickAt >= interval

terminator.firesAt: count onComplete, and also immediately on skip — exactly once per play

promotionPunch.guard: if (n <= curTier || !this.overlay) return — a tier can only ever go UP
order: additive flash of the OLD word

oldWordFlash.kind: additive clone of the OUTGOING tier-word sprite

endFlare.maxSwitch: if (finalTier === 3) promoteTier(3) at (at + maxBeat) — EPIC holds through the whole count, MAX slams in only AFTER the number has landed on the cap

steps.noPlateVariant: when no plate sprite exists the amount only fades (alpha 0, 0.4s, power2.in), no y move

steps.note: FUNCTION-BASED values, evaluated when the tween STARTS, so the drift grows from wherever the promotions left the marquee

absoluteTimelineByTier._note: DERIVED by substituting countDur/holdDur/maxBeat into the formulas above. countAt = 0.56 for every tier.
absoluteTimelineByTier.timelineEndFormula: exitAt + 0.6 (the marquee scale-drift is the longest exit tween: 0.6 > 0.14+0.45 > 0.55)

entranceFloor.note: the entrance shake deliberately uses min(finalTier,1) so even a BIG stamp thuds; the PROMOTIONS then escalate traumaMax/traumaRot to the real per-tier values

traumaModel.appliesTo: the WHOLE overlay (dim + coin rain + marquee move together)

chromaKey.note: TIGHT key so the gold bodies stay FULLY OPAQUE; box-aspect crop then ~1.42x upscale for sharpness

slicing.frameRectFormula: x = (local % cols) * fw, y = Math.floor(local / cols) * fh, w = fw, h = fh
slicing.order: row-major, sheets in the given order

placement.zOrder: added to the overlay BEFORE the marquee container, so it renders BEHIND the win screen (and AFTER the dim, so above it)

coinRain.firesWhen: on every celebration that reaches play(), immediately at t=0, gated on (coinFrames loaded && frames.length > 0 && !reduced). It is NOT tier-gated.
coinRain.warmUpNote: one invisible 4x4-frame sprite per sheet is rendered for ~150ms to bind the full source, otherwise the first celebration hitches while ~140MB/sheet uploads

ambientDuck.event: onMarqueeStart (fires inside play(), synchronously before the timeline is built)
ambientDuck.duckImplementation: howl.fade(howl.volume(), 0, ms) — the loop keeps running muted, it is NEVER stopped or restarted
ambientDuck.releaseEvent: onMarqueeExit(smooth) — fired by signalExit(), exactly once per play

releaseAt.skip: immediately on skip() / finish() / cancel(), smooth = false

ambientDuck.unduckImplementation: howl.fade(howl.volume(), effVolume(eventId), ms) — restores the BOUND volume unconditionally (mute is an orthogonal layer)
ambientDuck.note: the ambient fade-in runs PARALLEL to the marquee's staggered exit, so the handoff has no gap and no restart

domRailEvent.purpose: DOM rails (BONUS ACTIVE etc.) hide for the marquee — DOM always sits above the canvas

clickAdvance.rule: ONE tap = exactly ONE stage; it is NOT a full skip and clicks during the hold do nothing
clickAdvance.noFurtherThreshold: tl.seek(countAt + countDur[finalTier] - 0.001, false) — completes the count so the full win stands briefly, then the normal hold+exit
clickAdvance.seekTargetFormula: invert power1.inOut numerically: binary search 26 iterations on m in [elapsed/dur, 1] for the smallest m with ease(m) * finalVal >= th[n]; then tl.seek(countAt + Math.min(m * dur + 0.002, dur - 0.001), false)

reducedMotion.behaviour: no entrance, no count, no coin rain, no pulse (amp = 0): final tier layer + final amount are shown instantly at alpha 1

boardDim.condition: the dim Graphics is only created when WIN_CELEBRATION_CONFIG.dimAlpha > 0 && !reduced; the Vice call site passes only sizeMul, so setWinTierGeometry sets dimAlpha = geo?.dimAlpha ?? 0 = 0
boardDim.doNotBuild: the dev must NOT render a screen dim behind the Vice marquee

textFallbackPath.condition: used ONLY when the six layer textures failed to load (hasArt === false). Vice always loads them (src/App.tsx:708-711).
textFallbackPath.doNotBuild: the dev must NOT ship the drawn wordmark path for Vice

callSiteVice.trigger: PixiApp.playCoinWin(winAmount, wager, symbol, decimals, originsLocal) at the end of the ways win reveal, right after reelSet.highlightWins(outcome.winResult)
callSiteVice.centreFormula: sceneRoot.toGlobal({ x: (reelSet.totalWidth + FRAME_PAD * 2) / 2, y: HEADER_H + (reelSet.totalHeight + FRAME_PAD * 2) / 2 })
callSiteVice.coordSpace: screen pixels — the celebration overlay lives on app.stage, zIndex 10000, eventMode 'none' until the click-advance handler is attached

immersiveDetail._what: The parts of Vice's IMMERSIVE win reveal that the preset does not carry at all. Sibling of winPresentation.waysImmersive (which only ships enabled/dimAlpha/stagger).

coordinateSpace.space: grid-local pixels (ReelSet container), BEFORE the machine scale factor
coordinateSpace.cellCenterFormula: cx = reel*128 + 60 ; cy = row*116 + 55  (buildLayout: x = reel*(symbolWidth+reelGap), y = row*(symbolHeight+symbolGap))

tallyStep.why: PixiApp always passes '+' + formatWin(...), so amountText is never empty in Vice

entryPoints.intenseFalseNote: the softer 'resting loop' values (jump 10 / tilt 0.04 / slam 2.5) exist in code but NO Vice call site produces intense=false — revealCombo is the only caller and it always carries an amount

reducedMotionGate.rule: window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches -> playImmersiveReveal returns immediately, NOTHING dances and no micro-shake fires

tweenLifecycle.killedBy: clearWinLines() — kills every winFxTween then destroys winLinesContainer children; called at the top of revealCombo/highlightWins BEFORE restoreLiftedObjects, so every dance/shake onInterrupt restore writes lifted-space values

rule1_winSheetSymbols.meaning: a winning cell whose symbol has a WIN SPRITESHEET does NOT leap/wiggle/land — it plays its sheet ON POSITION, dead still. Any leap or zoom would warp the sheet.

viceSymbolIdsThatDoDanceNames.0: WILD — dances ONLY in the base game (1:1). In free spins a landed wild expands, so its reel is in expandedReels and rule2 excludes it.

rule1_winSheetSymbols._source: src/game/ReelSet.ts:2621-2624 (early continue); src/game/AnimatedSymbol.ts:38 (SYMBOL_WIN_SHEETS map); src/App.tsx:632-642 (the 5 Vice registrations); src/data/math_vice_heat.json custom.expandingWildsInFreeSpins=true (why WILD dances in base only); strips carry ids 0-8 only

rule1_sideEffects.note: AnimatedSymbol applies the SAME sheet rule independently: a sheet-carrying symbol in state 'win' gets NO white outline, and gets the fallback win pulse on `inner` in parallel with the sheet.

outlineForSheetlessWinners.alphaRule: fades IN with the win pulse's grow and OUT with its shrink (0 at rest)

rule2_expandedReels.meaning: no cell on an EXPANDED (tower) reel dances — those cells are hidden behind the tower sprite; the column thumps instead (see expandedTowerDuringWin)

rule3_dedupe.meaning: a cell that appears in several combos of the SAME call dances once (Set `seen` is per playImmersiveReveal call, not per combo)

danceTimeline.target: cell.objectLayer === AnimatedSymbol.inner (the icon/glyph/win-sheet container — win-state pulse lives on the same node, so they compose)
danceTimeline.delayFormula: delay = reelIndex * stagger  (ABSOLUTE reel column index, not the position inside the combo)
danceTimeline.restore: onComplete AND onInterrupt: obj.y = baseY; obj.rotation = baseRot (base captured at call time, i.e. already in lifted board coords)

trigger.maxMatchFormula: maxMatch = max(combo.matchCount) over the combos passed to playImmersiveReveal
trigger.note: in the tally the call carries ONE combo, so the shake is that combo's matchCount; in the finale it is the max over all winning combos

microShake.target: this.container — the whole ReelSet board container (all reels, towers, lifted objects move together)
microShake.preStep: killThud() first — a residual landing thud would displace the captured base
microShake.offsetFormula: for i in 0..4: f = 1 - i/5 ; x = base.x + (Math.random()-0.5)*2*amp*f ; y = base.y + (Math.random()-0.5)*2*amp*f

maxOffsetPerStepPx.note: peak |offset| per axis = amp*f (the (rand-0.5)*2 factor spans -1..+1)

expandedTowerDuringWin.dispatchRule: in applyCellHighlight, for reel i: if (expandedReels.has(i)) { if the combo has winning rows on i -> pulseExpandedReel(i); continue; } — the `continue` means the reel gets NO clearAllStates, NO playWinStateOnRows, NO per-cell highlight()/dim, and liftWinningObjects (ReelSet.ts:2166), flashWinCells (2241) and playImmersiveReveal (2617) all skip it too
expandedTowerDuringWin.description: physical column THUMP: the tower dips 5px and squashes vertically to 98.5%, then springs back elastically. Top-anchored, so it compresses downward like weight landing on it. No overlay flash, no white pop, no alpha change.
expandedTowerDuringWin.targetSprite: expandedTowerSprites.get(reel).spr — the wild_column.webp Sprite in stickyContainer
expandedTowerDuringWin.onComplete: splice self out of stickyRevealTweens, then startTowerIdle(reelIdx)

idleBreathing.note: resumes after every thump; pure scale, NO y-bob (the reveal mask would crop the head)
idleBreathing.phaseFormula: phase = Math.random() * 1.3  (per tower, so columns never breathe in lockstep)

basePose.growthModeNote: Vice never calls setExpandGrowth (only Crack Farm sets 'bottom-up' at src/App.tsx:284), so ReelSet.expandGrowth stays the 'race' default (ReelSet.ts:836)
basePose.baseYFormula: baseY = reelRect.y  (race mode; bottom-up would be reelRect.y + reelRect.h)
basePose.baseScaleFormula: baseScale = reelRect.w * 0.98 / texture.width  (width-fit, tall narrow art)
basePose.baseScaleNote: 0.2296875 = 120*0.98/512 for the shipped wild_column.webp (512x2560). Recompute if the art width changes.

towerBadgePulse.note: SEPARATE from the thump — pulseTowerBadges() is only called from the multiplier tick-up branch of spawnComboAmount, which is INERT in Vice (see comboAmountLabel.multiplierRamp)

comboAmountLabel.spawnCondition: ONLY when revealCombo receives amountText — i.e. once per tally step. highlightWins (the finale) spawns NO label.

spawnPosition.formula: centroid of the combo's cell centres: cx = mean(cellCenterX), cy = mean(cellCenterY) over comboPoints(combo) — cells sorted by reel, duplicates on the same reel counted individually

mainLabel.fontWeightCaveat: Rubik is imported at weights 400;500;600;700 only (src/styles/globals.css:3) — the 900 is browser-synthesised/clamped to 700. Import the same weights to match, do NOT swap in a real Rubik 900.

waysSubline.waysSource: WinEvaluator: ways = product of matching-symbol counts on the matched reels (src/engine/WinEvaluator.ts:156-160); max 3125 on 5x5. Scatter combos are built with ways: 1 (WinEvaluator.ts:99) so a scatter win NEVER shows the subline.
waysSubline.fillExpr: this.winFrameColor — WIN_FRAME_COLOR default (ReelSet.ts:45, 304); Vice never calls setWinColors and the winLineColor param default 'gold' resolves to the identical pair {line 0xFFC53D, frame 0xFFF1B0}
waysSubline.yFormula: ways.y = label.height * 0.46  (label.height = the rendered height of the main Text incl. stroke — runtime-measured, not a constant)

comboAmountLabel.sink: winAmountTweens (cleared by clearWinAmounts, NOT by clearWinLines — labels are not killed by the next tally step)

overlapNote.tallyStepMsFormula: ordered.length > 5 ? 380 : (lines ? 700 : 600) — Vice is ways, so 600 ms, or 380 ms with more than 5 winning combos
overlapNote.consequence: the label lives 1.1 s but the next step starts after 0.6 s, so two (or three at 380 ms) amount labels are visible simultaneously by design

multiplierRamp.whyInertInVice: Vice's tower multipliers set multApplied only (src/game/viceSpin.ts:233); baseText/finalText are set exclusively on the Crack Farm plant paths (src/game/PixiApp.ts:2496-2501, 2607-2612, 4584-4586). With the two text fields missing the branch is skipped and the PLAIN float path above runs.

sideEffectThatDOESApplyToVice.rule: PixiApp still reads multApplied > 1 and stretches that tally step: await max(stepMs, 1250) ms instead of 600 ms — a Vice tower-multiplied connection holds ~1.25 s with a static label

wouldBeValues.note: for reference only — do NOT build this for Vice

winLine.suppressedAt: src/game/ReelSet.ts:2813 — `if (waysImmersiveConfig.enabled) return;` at the top of buildDecoration()

wouldBeValues.path: polyline through the combo's cell centres, sorted by reel

revealMaskSweep.suppressedAt: src/game/ReelSet.ts:2813 (buildDecoration early return); additionally guarded at 2875 by `lineLayer.children.length > 0`, which is 0 in immersive mode anyway

fullBoardLightBand.secondGate: also requires !waysLightConfig.enabled (ReelSet.ts:2897), which is false by default

wouldBeValues.bounds: x0 = minX-30, x1 = maxX+30, yTop = minY-60, yBot = maxY+60; h = yBot-yTop

suppressedAt: src/game/ReelSet.ts:2124 — same test inside fireWaysLightSequential(), so the whole line-by-line loop returns on the first combo

wouldBeValues.grouping: winning cells grouped by reel, left to right; one thin beam per bipartite connection between adjacent reels
wouldBeValues.edgeToEdgeExtension: only for PAYLINE combos carrying linePath (+/-8 px past the first/last reel) — Vice is ways, so no linePath

whiteRecolorWinnerFlash.suppressedAt: src/game/ReelSet.ts:2239 — `if (waysImmersiveConfig.enabled) return;` at the top of flashWinCells()
whiteRecolorWinnerFlash.whatItIs: additive radial BACKLIGHT sprite behind each winning cell (the earlier brightness-filter version bleached the art and was replaced)

boardDim.suppressionKind: VALUE, not early-return — the immersive branch RUNS but writes alpha 1.0, so nothing visibly dims
boardDim.code: highlight(isWinning): if (waysImmersiveConfig.enabled) gsap.to(this, { alpha: isWinning ? 1.0 : waysImmersiveConfig.dimAlpha, duration: 0.18, ease: 'power2.out' })
boardDim.preStep: gsap.killTweensOf(this, 'alpha') so rapid combo cycling never stacks
boardDim.appliedTo: every visible cell of every NON-expanded reel (expanded reels are skipped by the applyCellHighlight `continue`)

tally._what: The per-combination TALLY inside PixiApp.playWinSequence: one winning connection revealed at a time, each floating its own +amount, then a single all-lit finale that hands off to the coin/marquee ceremony. There is no loop and no repeat pass.

gate.expression: const combos = outcome.winResult.combinations.filter(c => c.winAmount > 0n); const tally = combos.length > 0 && !this.turbo && !prefersReducedMotion();
gate.minComboCountNote: no threshold above zero — a SINGLE combo also gets its own tally step (PixiApp.ts:3700-3702 explicitly removed the old skip-to-finale shortcut)
gate.turboSource: this.turbo, set from React at src/App.tsx:1065
gate.whenGateFails: the whole per-combo pass is skipped; playWinSequence goes straight to the finale (highlightWins + coin ceremony). The finale is NOT gated.

order.meaning: SMALLEST win first, LARGEST win last — the escalation builds into the finale. Do not reverse.
order.tieBreak: comparator returns 0 for equal amounts; Array.prototype.sort is stable, so equal-paying combos keep the evaluator's original order

cadence.linesStepMsCondition: only when activePayModel() === 'lines'; Vice resolves to 'ways' (src/game/winEval.ts:16-23), so 700 is never used
cadence.towerMultipliedStepMsNote: resolves to exactly 1250 for both 380 and 600, since both are below the floor
cadence.waitPlacement: the wait happens AFTER revealCombo + the audio hook, so the first combo appears at t=0 and the sequence ends one full step after the last reveal
cadence.preTallyQuietBeatCondition: payModel === 'lines' only (PixiApp.ts:3718-3721) — Vice has NO pause before the first reveal

perStepBoardActions._source: src/game/ReelSet.ts:2074-2088 (revealCombo), called once per step from src/game/PixiApp.ts:3725
orderOfOperations: clearWinLines() — kill the previous combo's fx tweens and empty winLinesContainer (ReelSet.ts:3240-3245)
restoreLiftedObjects() — the previous combo's object layers drop back into their cells
applyCellHighlight(combo.cells) — this combo's rows enter the 'win' state; every cell alpha-tweens (ReelSet.ts:2188-2211)
liftWinningObjects(combo.cells) — winning object layers raised into winObjectsContainer at the cell centre
playImmersiveReveal([combo], true) — the leap dance, intense=true because an amountText was passed
spawnComboAmount(combo, '+' + formatWin(amount, decimals)) — the floating amount

dimBetweenSteps.note: waysImmersiveConfig.dimAlpha = 1.0 → there is NO dim in Vice; the alpha tween still runs but both targets are 1.0. The classic non-immersive path would snap non-winners to 0.25 — do not build that.

perStepBoardActions.winStateOnWinners: this.reels[i].playWinStateOnRows(rows) after clearAllStates() on that reel (ReelSet.ts:2203-2204) — symbols with a win spritesheet play the sheet, the rest play the 'win' pulse

expandedTowerReels.behaviour: a reel in expandedReels is skipped for cell highlight/win-state entirely; if the combo pays through it, pulseExpandedReel(i) thumps the tower column instead

leapDance.timeline: y -= 18 over 0.15s power3.out @0; rot -0.08 over 0.08s sine.inOut @0.04; rot +0.08 over 0.12s sine.inOut @0.12; rot 0 over 0.12s sine.out @0.24; y += 5 over 0.11s power3.in @0.22; y back over 0.3s back.out(3.5) @0.33
leapDance.viceSymbolsThatSkipTheLeapNote: the ids that have a win spritesheet registered in the Vice branch (scatter 1, prem A 2, prem B 3, car 4, koffer 5) — they play their sheet dead still on position; ids 0, 6, 7, 8 leap

buildDecoration.condition: early-returns while waysImmersiveConfig.enabled — no win line, no node dots, no sparkles, no light sweep

playComboComet.condition: only called on the lines branch (PixiApp.ts:3728)

amountsNotClearedBetweenSteps.fact: clearWinLines() does NOT clear winAmountsContainer; only clearHighlights() does (ReelSet.ts:2159)
amountsNotClearedBetweenSteps.consequence: each floating amount self-destroys after its own ~1.1s tween, so at the 380ms cadence up to 3 amounts are on screen at once. This overlap is intended behaviour, not a bug.

floatingAmount.anchorPoint: arithmetic mean of the combo's cell centres

waysSubline.fillConst: WIN_FRAME_COLOR (ReelSet.ts:45) — Vice never calls setWinColors, so the default holds

towerMultiplierPlaqueRamp._source: src/game/ReelSet.ts:2978-3009; Vice combo build at src/game/viceSpin.ts:217-237
towerMultiplierPlaqueRamp.condition: (combo.multApplied ?? 1) > 1 AND combo.baseText AND combo.finalText must all be present
towerMultiplierPlaqueRamp.whyInertInVice: viceSpin.applyTowerMultipliers sets ONLY multApplied (viceSpin.ts:233). baseText/finalText are attached exclusively on the Crack Farm plant paths (PixiApp.ts:2497-2501, 2609-2613, 4584-4587).
